newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to try 22 on charges of Islamic militancy.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to try 22 on charges of Islamic militancy.

text.p: Egypt will put 22 men on trial next month charged with belonging to the country's largest Moslem militant group, security sources said on Thursday.
The sources said the trial, at a Cairo state security court, will open on August 3.
A charge sheet obtained by Reuters said the defendants were charged with belonging to an illegal organisation seeking to overthrow the government.
The sources identified the group as the Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group) which has been fighting since 1992 to transform Egypt into a purist Islamic state.

Some of the defendants also face charges of illegal possession of weapons and explosives, forgery of official documents and plotting to kill high-ranking officials, tourists and policemen, the charge sheet added.

More than 1,000 people have been killed and scores more wounded since the Gama'a and other militant organisation began their struggle to topple the government. Security crackdowns have largely curtailed their activities.
